status.main_product: Drone survey services and integrated aerial data analytics
status.scope_reason: The company actively operates commercial drone services including large-scale surveying, mapping, and industrial asset inspection for external corporate and government clients under its own name.
status.evidence: Aereo, formerly known as Aarav Unmanned Systems, provides end-to-end commercial drone services, mapping, and aerial intelligence solutions according to its official website and press releases regarding its recent $15 million Series B funding round in July 2024.

claims.claim: The company manufactures and operates the AARAV_ENX6 series of fixed-wing VTOL hybrid UAVs, including the type-certified AARAV_ENX6MC model optimized for mapping and surveillance.
claims.corrected: VTOL Aviation India manufactures and operates the AARAV_ENX6 series of fixed-wing VTOL hybrid UAVs, including the type-certified AARAV_ENX6MC model optimized for mapping and surveillance.

claims.claim: The company reported filing 15 patents covering advancements in drone hardware, design, and predictive flight planning technologies, with one patent officially granted.
claims.note: The status of officially granted patents and the specific fields covered could not be independently confirmed.

claims.claim: The company indigenously developed and launched the Aereo INP, which was type certified by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) in October 2023 as India's first survey-grade PPK drone.

The company (doing business as Aereo) provides end-to-end commercial drone services covering large-scale aerial surveys, 3D GIS mapping, asset and industrial inspection, precision agriculture, and infrastructure monitoring.

Aereo's service portfolio integrates proprietary cloud platforms (Aereo Cloud) and AI-driven data analytics pipelines to process raw drone-captured imagery into volumetric analysis, orthomosaics, digital elevation models (DEMs), and contour maps for mining, construction, and urban land sectors.

The company operates the Aereo Cloud platform (formerly associated with Aarav Unmanned Systems), a MEITY-compliant, web-based 3D GIS environment that utilizes proprietary machine learning data pipelines to process raw drone-captured imagery into orthomosaics, digital terrain models (DTMs), 3D tilesets, and volumetric analysis assets.

The platform incorporates sector-specific, department-wise dashboards (e.g., for Planning, Production, Safety) featuring tools for ML-driven deviation detection, volume computations, slope analysis, and haul road tracking, which have been deployed for enterprise mining analytics at operations like Coal India's Digicoal initiative and Tata Steel.

The company (now rebranded as Aereo) reports that its flagship multicopter drone, Insight, became the first small-category drone to receive type certification from the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) under the No-Permission No-Takeoff compliance framework in September 2019.
claims.corrected: The company (now rebranded as Aereo) reports that its flagship multicopter drone, Insight, became the first small-category drone to receive certification from the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) under the No-Permission No-Takeoff compliance framework in September 2019.

claims.claim: The company reports obtaining subsequent DGCA type certification for its Aereo ZFR fixed-wing VTOL small-category drone model in June 2023.

Aarav Unmanned Systems (operating as Aereo) won a three-year, $1-million commercial contract from Coal India Limited (CIL) announced in March 2023 to provide proprietary survey drones and advanced analytics across seven open-cast mines under Northern Coalfields Ltd. and South Eastern Coalfields Ltd.

The company secured a major enterprise mandate from Tata Steel in 2021, including a two-year rate contract for physical verification of inventory at 23 distinct sites, which was further expanded by signing a Joint Development Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in July 2022 to co-develop sustainable drone-based digital solutions for open-cast mining operations.
claims.note: The details regarding a two-year rate contract for physical verification of inventory at 23 distinct sites in 2021 are unverified.

claims.claim: Aarav Unmanned Systems Private Limited (operating as Aereo) reported a total operating revenue of ₹59.7 crore for FY24, which is a 13.6% year-on-year growth from ₹52.6 crore in FY23, alongside an annual net loss of ₹12.5 crore.
The company successfully secured a $15 million Series B funding round led by 360 ONE Asset in July 2024 to expand its drone-based business intelligence and capital asset management solutions.

Aarav Unmanned Systems (operating as Aereo) won competitive government bidding contracts to deploy its proprietary survey-grade drones across multiple Indian states, including mapping projects across Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Haryana.
claims.corrected: Aarav Unmanned Systems (operating as Aereo) won competitive government bidding contracts to deploy its proprietary survey-grade drones across multiple Indian states, including mapping projects across Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Haryana.

claims.claim: The company serves as the core technology partner utilizing its drone solutions to map 86,000 square kilometres across 10 districts in the state of Karnataka under a large-scale land parcel mapping contract.
claims.corrected: The company serves as the core technology partner utilizing its drone solutions to map 68,000 square kilometres across 10 districts in the state of Karnataka under a large-scale land parcel mapping contract.

claims.claim: Aereo (formerly Aarav Unmanned Systems) entered into a global go-to-market partnership with Datamine to deliver artificial intelligence-enabled drone solutions for the mining sector.
The company signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Tata Steel in July 2022 to jointly develop and deploy integrated drone-based solutions and analytics for open cast mining operations.
The company reports a team of over 300 engineers, designers, and technicians.
The company has deployed managed drone operations across multiple states in India, including mapping projects covering more than 40,000 villages under the government SVAMITVA scheme.

status.main_product: Drone services including industrial inspection, mapping, and aerial surveying
status.scope_reason: The company directly operates Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) operations providing aerial imaging, wind turbine, solar, and powerline inspection services to external clients under its own name.
status.evidence: According to its official website, AiRotor Labs is an Ahmedabad-headquartered drone services company providing industrial inspection, aerial survey, and AI-driven analytics across India.

claims.claim: The company reports deploying its custom-manufactured hardware, including the AiRotor Industrial X-Series, Surveyor Pro, 5G quad, payload dropping, Enterprise Custom, FPV, Fire & safety, and Heavy payload drone platforms.

The company reports using external commercial platforms for specific missions, verified by a case study confirming the deployment of DJI Matrice 350 RTK and M30T drones equipped with Zenmuse H30T dual thermal-RGB sensors.
claims.note: deployment of DJI Matrice 350 RTK and M30T drones equipped with Zenmuse H30T dual thermal-RGB sensors

claims.claim: The company reports that it custom-engineers industrial drone hardware, including its Industrial X-Series, Surveyor Pro, and 5G quad, designed and manufactured in Ahmedabad.

The company reports that its operations are DGCA-compliant, carrying Unmanned Aircraft Operator Permits (UAOP), Remote Pilot Licenses (RPL), Digital Sky flight permissions, and ₹1 Crore third-party liability insurance.
The company reports having BVLOS-capable operations for long-corridor linear missions exceeding 20 kilometers using fixed-wing or VTOL platforms under appropriate DGCA permissions.
claims.note: BVLOS-capable operations for long-corridor linear missions exceeding 20 kilometers using fixed-wing or VTOL platforms

claims.claim: The company reports serving over 20 direct and indirect clients as trusted partners, including notable industry entities such as Adani, Reliance, Larsen & Toubro, Tata Projects, Vestas, Suzlon, Azure Power, Vikram Solar, ReNew Energy, EDF Renewables, SPRNG Energy, Arth Renewables, Hindustan Zinc Limited, Candi Solar, and RotorTech.

The company states it has deployed its drone solutions for utility-scale solar farm thermal inspections, wind turbine blade inspections, and land surveys across Indian states like Gujarat, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Maharashtra, citing operations at large-scale sites such as the 2,245 MW Bhadla solar park and a 500-acre industrial zone in Dholera SIR.

AiRotor Labs Pvt. Ltd. supported a two-day drone training program organized for faculty members and students at the DroneX Innovation Lab under the Department of Computer Engineering and Technology at Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT-WPU, Pune on 12–13 October 2026. ·Dhanashri Wategaonkar - Savagave

The company reports having an official headcount tier of 2 to 10 employees and utilizing DGCA-certified remote pilots and UAV engineers to run operations out of its corporate headquarters in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
The company has demonstrated a flight deployment covering a 500-acre land topographical survey project in the Dholera Special Investment Region using a single drone crew over a span of 4 days.
